difficulty_reason: Pushforward along a morphism of categories fibred in groupoids representable by algebraic spaces: proves the induced functor u on slice sites is continuous by rewriting a tau-covering of Y as a base change of a scheme-theoretic covering, then identifies f_*F(y) with F(u(y)) because u(y) is a final object of the indexing category of the limit formula for the pushforward. Retained author proof at lines 888-914.
